rules.conflict_note: Section 6.b bars municipalities from enacting ordinances that conflict with this act; local algorithmic rent-setting bans (Jersey City, Hoboken) may be preempted from 2027-07-01 to the extent they conflict.
rules.interaction: Section 6.b prohibits conflicting municipal ordinances, except those explicitly authorized or required by other law.
rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: Landlords may not pay for or use a coordinator's rent-setting algorithm that pools nonpublic information from competing owners, and no one may perform that coordinating function. It takes effect on 2027-07-01.
rules.key_value: Ban on algorithmic coordination of rent, lease terms or occupancy using competitors' nonpublic data
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental property owners, coordinators and their agents; any residential dwelling unit used as a primary residence in NJ
rules.exemptions: Government affordability controls; public research or testing; free public rent estimates; equal-terms brokerage databases; simple spreadsheets and plain database queries
rules.quoted_span: any person to perform a coordinating function.

notes: Effective date per section 9: first day of the twelfth month after approval on 2026-07-20 = 2027-07-01 (computed, consistent with the brief). Amended by first reprint; enforcement is under the NJ Antitrust Act.
